comment: Day 5 CI merge safety: quality-gate now runs on pull_request with secret-backed gates disabled by default; auto-merge refuses risky release/auth/privacy paths and requires non-author cross-agent approval. Verified release privacy static test, plutil, strict preflight, diff check, and Release iOS simulator build.
